name: Matsukawa (Japan, town)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Matsukawa town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of a letter V with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Matsukawa, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1967.

features.role: Matsukawa town emblem — a stylised angular device of a letter V with a ring
